Slingshot

Shader reference — Rendering v2: R2.1 stars, R2.2 rocky planets, R2.3 gas giants

Left: the approved SVG (design/assets/…, as an image). Right: the reference shader running live in WebGL with the numbers from design/shader-specs.md (stars shaders/star.frag §2 at 1.5×; rocky planets shaders/planet.frag §3 at 3×, with the maps in shaders/maps/). The game's shaders should match the right-hand column. Add ?t=13.9 to the URL to freeze the clock (13.9 s shows the sun's flare); &only=stars, planets or giants shows one family.

R2.2 rocky planets3× · a baked surface map on a rotating sphere, lit by uLight; locked bodies use a face map

R2.3 gas giants and ringsa baked band strip on a sphere with differential rotation; ring planes in 3D with the planet's shadow and the ring shadow

One impostor quad per body (each canvas here; the page shares one WebGL context and copies each frame into a 2D canvas, because browsers cap live WebGL contexts at about 16); premultiplied alpha, blend ONE, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA. All star motion is cosmetic and runs on frame.now. Values: design/shader-specs.md.
